title: Representative-normalized completed coefficient tensor transport models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$ and the recorded uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On a scheme's small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use $R_W=\lim_n(A/t^{n+1})_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the constant sheaf $\underline A_W$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], ordinary module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define a representative-normalized completed tensor transport presentation as follows. First, for any symmetric monoidal category $D$, endofunctor $C$, unit $\eta:1\to C$ and full subcategory $P$, a reflected tensor presentation comprises a symmetric monoidal structure on $P$, natural identifications $\iota(M\widehat\otimes N)\simeq C(\iota M\otimes\iota N)$ and $\iota(1_P)\simeq C(1_D)$, and a lax braided structure on $\iota$ whose tensor and coefficient maps are exactly $\eta$ followed by the inverse of these identifications. Thus its associators, both unitors and symmetry are normalized by the actual completion unit. At $W$, a site presentation consists of the recorded exact derived restriction model $U$ [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], a principal strict-quotient completion model $C^A,\eta^A$ [def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model] for the constant uniformizer section (and use the recorded completed uniformizer section [def-sp-completed-uniformizer-section]), and an ordinary representative-normalized closed symmetric tensor model on constant coefficients [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model]. Use the recorded $C^R,\eta^R,\widehat\otimes_R$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Include $d:UC^R\simeq C^AU$ with $d\,U\eta^R=\eta^A$, the reflector Hom bijections and completeness of both outputs, equivalence of invertibility of $\eta^R$ with the recorded derived-completeness predicate [def-weil-derived-complete], and equivalence of completeness of $K$ and $UK$. Include reflected tensor presentations on both complete full subcategories. The tensor transport datum consists of an equivalence whose forward functor is exactly the lift of $U$, a strong monoidal structure on that functor preserving symmetry, and an ambient balancing natural map $UM\otimes_A^LUN\to U(M\otimes_R^LN)$. For every pair of flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex] [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], its representative is the map of total tensors sending each local homogeneous $x\otimes y$ to the same $x\otimes y$, via the recorded tensor-model and exact-restriction comparisons. There must be one map of their entire strict principal quotient towers, invertible at every level, intertwining this balancing map and both quotient augmentations; its naturality includes all quotient transitions. Define $a:U(M\widehat\otimes_RN)\simeq UM\widehat\otimes_AUN$ by the inverse strong tensorator and the two reflected-tensor identifications. Define its unit-normalization property to be $a\,U\eta^R\,\mu=\eta^A$. This defines the data and predicates, without asserting their existence.
